title: The pulmonary trip begins
hook: Trace one part of the circulation.

knows: The heart has atria and ventricles.
doesNotKnow: The right ventricle pumps blood toward the lungs through the pulmonary trunk and arteries. In the lungs, gas exchange can add oxygen to the blood.

misconception: Blood passes randomly between the four chambers.
objective: Trace the specified step in normal mammalian circulation.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: The right ventricle pumps blood through the pulmonary artery toward which organ? The right ventricle pumps blood toward the lungs through the pulmonary trunk and arteries. In the lungs, gas exchange can add oxygen to the blood.
